text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One big change is automation. Machines and software can now do repetitive tasks, such as organizing data or answering customer questions. This saves time and lets workers focus on more important jobs. There are also new productivity tools that help people plan their work, write emails, or find information quickly. Many companies now support human-AI collaboration, where people and AI work together as a team. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay successful in a modern workplace.
